title: 第五章 群星铭刻第六章 寻宝
lines: 西隆返回自己的巢。
雏龙的巢说是龙巢，其实就是几块石头围起来的地方。
不过龙类一直对筑巢有很重的情结，既然不能跟喂哺者同居，西隆破壳之后，便一直将筑巢视作重中之重。
那时他在出生地附近转了一整天，考察了不少地点，才选定山坳背面这一块岩下缓坡。
这里一来地势好，避风避雨、视野开阔不积水，二来远离山谷核心，迦卓萨的感知能够顾及，又不会有雏龙轻易路过打扰。
从条件上来说，算是非常不错。
赭石谷里岩石随处可见，可并非所有石头都适合筑巢。
小铬龙在山谷里兜兜转转，花了很长时间，寻找那些单面较平、大小合适的方石，找到了就用爪子和牙齿往回拖，再一块块把它们垒成墙面。
接着他又从山溪里挖来砂砾，在巢里铺上细细一层，蹦跃起跳，把它们踩实压紧，最后取来一捧蓬松的麦杆用来枕头，才终于搭出自己的小窝。
尽管这个巢看起来其貌不扬，但胜在安静、干净，又是自己一点点动手完成的，所以小铬龙每次躺在砂石上滚来滚去的时候，心里都有种奇妙的满足感。
这时西隆匍匐身躯，像只大猫似的倚躺下来。
训练已经结束，他嘴里的伤口却仍在渗血，整个面孔都一阵一阵的痛。
但或许是因为精神上的疲惫，躺下之后，他感受着腹下砂石由凉变温，很快便觉得意识昏沉，渐渐地想要睡去。
远处隐约响起轻缓的唱颂声。
声音遥远，声调也低，所以有些模糊，西隆听了，只以为是喂哺者在施放什么法术，所以并不在意。
但是过了一会，他又发觉不对，因为那声音已经持续很久，不像施法，更像是哪只雏龙在故作深沉、唱诵传承里的诗歌。
西隆皱起额间的鳞，换了个姿势，把脑袋埋在膜翼下面。
吟唱声庄严起来，声音也越来越大，重重叠叠的，最后每一句都变得隆重非常。
简直像是人群在耳边合唱，激昂慷慨、纵声高歌，发出近乎轰鸣的声音。
该死，灰矮人狂欢节？
看样子是睡不成了。
西隆有些恼火的站起来，晃晃脑袋，离开巢穴，打算去看看究竟怎么回事。
赭石谷的夜晚无星无月，正被前所未有的大雾笼罩着。
铬龙沿着声音传来的方向往前走，浓雾里带着湿润的潮气，明明还是秋天，可是不知为何气温却陡然低了很多。
空气冰凉，吸进肺里，让龙也有种想要颤栗的错觉。
随着他的步伐向前推进，浓雾缓缓向两侧退开，周围事物渐渐从白茫茫里显现出轮廓，起初只是模糊的线条，像是被水晕开的墨，接着线条清晰，连成形状。
西隆忽然怔住，浑身鳞片沿着肌肉水波般翕动，一片片绷紧又松开。
脚下的土地……
不见了。
他放眼四顾，脚下不再是赭石谷的砂石，而是一片广袤无垠、黑得发亮的镜面，平整得看不见一丝褶皱，延伸向无限远的尽头。
吟唱声不知何时悄悄停了，周围只剩下深不见底的寂静。
到了这个时候，西隆已经反应过来，意识到自己恐怕是在做梦了，亦或是产生了某种幻觉、灵视。
因为如果身处现实，那么高亢庄严的吟唱声，不能只有他一条龙听见，可直到现在，包括强大的喂哺者在内，附近没有任何生灵出来查看。
如果说是专门针对他的幻境或传送，好像也不太可能，谁会花这么大力气戏弄一条雏龙？
content_en:
Shillong returns to his nest.
The young dragon's nest is said to be a dragon's nest, but it is actually a place surrounded by a few stones.
However, dragons have always had a strong attachment to nest building. Since they cannot live with their feeders, Shillong has always regarded nest building as a top priority after breaking out of its shell.
At that time, he spent a whole day walking around the place where he was born and inspected many places before choosing the gentle slope on the back of the col.
First of all, the terrain here is good, sheltered from wind and rain, with a wide view and no accumulation of water. Secondly, it is far away from the core of the valley, Gadrosa's perception can be taken into account, and no young dragons will easily pass by and disturb them.
In terms of conditions, it's pretty good.
Rocks can be found everywhere in the Ocher Valley, but not all rocks are suitable for nesting.
The little chrome dragon walked around in the valley and spent a long time looking for square stones with a flat side and suitable size. When he found them, he dragged them back with his claws and teeth, and then built them into a wall piece by piece.
Then he dug gravel from the mountain stream, spread a thin layer of gravel in the nest, jumped up and down, pressed it firmly, and finally took a handful of fluffy straw to use as a pillow, and finally built his own nest.
Although this nest looks unattractive, it is quiet, clean, and was completed bit by bit by myself. Therefore, every time the little chrome dragon rolls around on the gravel, he feels a strange sense of satisfaction.
At this time, Shillong crawled and lay down like a big cat.
The training was over, but the wound in his mouth was still bleeding, and his whole face was in pain.
But perhaps it was due to mental exhaustion. After lying down, he felt the sand and gravel under his abdomen change from cold to warm. He soon felt drowsy and gradually wanted to fall asleep.
There was a faint sound of gentle chanting in the distance.
The voice was distant and low-pitched, so it was a bit vague. When Shillong heard it, he just thought it was the feeder casting some spell, so he didn't care.
But after a while, he realized something was wrong, because the sound had lasted for a long time. It didn't sound like casting a spell, but more like a young dragon pretending to be deep and singing a poem from the inheritance.
Shillong wrinkled the scales on his forehead, changed his position, and buried his head under the membrane wings.
The chanting became more solemn, and the voice became louder and louder, overlapping each other, and finally each sentence became very solemn.
It was like the crowd was singing a chorus in their ears, singing passionately and loudly, making a sound that was almost roaring.
Damn it, duergar carnival?
It looked like he couldn't sleep.
Shillong stood up angrily, shook his head, and left the lair, intending to see what was going on.
The night in Ocher Valley is starless and moonless, and is shrouded in unprecedented heavy fog.
Chrome Dragon walked forward in the direction of the sound. The thick fog was filled with moisture. It was obviously still autumn, but for some reason the temperature suddenly dropped much lower.
The air was cold and breathed into his lungs, making Longya feel like he wanted to shiver.
As he moved forward, the dense fog slowly receded to both sides, and the outlines of the surrounding objects gradually emerged from the white. At first, they were just blurry lines, like ink dizzy by water, and then the lines became clear and connected into shapes.
Shillong suddenly froze, and the scales all over his body moved like waves along his muscles, tensing and loosening one by one.
The ground beneath your feet...
Gone.
He looked around, and there was no longer the sand and gravel of the Ocher Valley under his feet, but a vast, shiny black mirror, so flat that no wrinkles could be seen, extending to the infinity end.
The singing stopped quietly at some point, leaving only bottomless silence around.
By this time, Shillong had already reacted and realized that he was probably dreaming, or had some kind of hallucination or vision.
Because if we were in reality, then he alone could not hear the high-pitched and solemn chanting, but until now, no living beings nearby, including the powerful Feeder, had come out to check.
If it was an illusion or teleportation specifically aimed at him, it seemed unlikely. Who would spend so much effort teasing a young dragon?
